cef1b57b:  ;
 ;Main routine to print report of total dollar amounts
 ;of delinquent accounts receivable for an entire division
 ;or each division in the entire system.
272e8f5e: ;Print the total dollar amount for each division.
76d143f6: ;Routine exit point.
1bab6aff: ;Print the report header.
465cd7cd: ;Print blank lines to create space at the bottom of the page.
8a3b9e11: ;Retrieve and print the last date the division was added or edited.
53d25a43: Check if the device is not a terminal (C) or a console (OS is MSM by Mumps standards).
cc32eea3: Get user input to continue or quit; set flag DGFLAG if continue.
d9db2bd8: Reset page number if printing a different header.
30874f87: Print header information including report type, date, and page number.
5bdde1f2: If the listing is by event date, print column headers for event date, patient name, and patient ID.
68815e51: Output header columns for patient name, patient ID, event date
4ce22aa6: Output header columns for discharge type, location, and borrower
133eeb99: For records not related to physicians, output header columns for physician, type, and (if direction is 2) status and total days
8c23a080: For records related to physicians, output header columns for type, and (if direction is 2) status and total days
fcbad9ca: Exit the code block
87a9399b: Clean up (kill) all local variables used in the routine
a4464200: ;Kill and initialize variables used in the program.
3018ce56: Clear utility global nodes for this job.
560a45d4: Close terminal connection on exit.
bb463018: If data exists for physician and patient, print count of procedures for physician and division, and display procedure data if output is not to terminal.
21a51925: If data exists for service/specialty and patient, print count of procedures for service/specialty and division.
c45cbcd8: ;If there is data continue, else print subtotal and quit.
365ada6b: ;Quit routine.
47b5f6c5: ;Print header with 3-character code from VAS file if exists, else print blank.
428facb2: If the patient is at a transfer institution, print the first 10 characters of the station name. Otherwise, print a blank space.
25e247ab: Print the length of stay (DGJTDL) for the patient, right-justified and taking up 4 character spaces.
3426d723: Exit the routine.
